Kwame, I couldn't set up the daily digest yet. The scheduler rejected the request with a gateway authentication error, so no recurring job exists.

I checked the channel side. You're a member of #coastal-team, so I can read it and build the digest from it. The first run would be tomorrow, 2026-10-15, at 09:00 Chicago time, if the scheduler is working.

The digest will list new items from #coastal-team: topics, who posted, and any decisions, tickets, dates or open questions. It will leave out money terms and finance documents, and say when such items exist in the channel. It will also stop and tell you if you're no longer a member of the channel.

The fix needs someone with access to the Gateway config (`/harness-state/openclaw/openclaw.json`), since the gateway needs its auth token or a paired device. I haven't changed anything there. Once the scheduler is back, send me "set up the digest" again and I'll create it.
